places.name: Claude Monet's House and Gardens
places.connection: Monet's residence and studio where he created many of his works.

places.name: Musée Marmottan Monet
places.connection: Houses the largest collection of Monet's works, including 'Impression, Sunrise'.

places.name: Musée d'Orsay
places.connection: Houses a significant collection of Impressionist artworks.

places.name: Le Havre
places.connection: Depicted in Monet's 'Impression, Sunrise', which gave Impressionism its name.

places.name: Giverny
places.connection: Location depicted in Claude Monet's paintings, notably his Water Lilies series.
